# New Hope Immigration Services (English)

> New Hope Immigration Services is a nonprofit organization in Florida (USA) providing low-cost immigration document preparation and guidance. We are not a law firm. Phone: +1 407 275-6163. English-language site.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://newhopevisa.com/en/): English homepage.
- [Services](https://newhopevisa.com/en/services/): Overview of immigration services offered.
- [Fee schedule](https://newhopevisa.com/en/fee-schedule/): Service fees (USCIS filing fees not included).
- [About us](https://newhopevisa.com/en/about-us/): Mission, team, and organization background.
- [Contact us](https://newhopevisa.com/en/contact-us/): Contact form and ways to reach the team.

## Immigration services

- [Work permit (EAD)](https://newhopevisa.com/en/work-permit/): Employment authorization documents.
- [Travel documents](https://newhopevisa.com/en/travel-documents/): Advance parole and travel authorization.
- [Family petitions](https://newhopevisa.com/en/family-petitions/): Family reunification and I-130 petitions.
- [Adjustment of status](https://newhopevisa.com/en/adjustment-of-status/): Green card while in the U.S. (I-485).
- [Consular processing](https://newhopevisa.com/en/consular-processing/): Immigrant visas through U.S. consulates.
- [Naturalization](https://newhopevisa.com/en/naturalization/): U.S. citizenship (Form N-400).
- [Residence renewal (I-90)](https://newhopevisa.com/en/residence-renewals-i-90/): Green card renewal or replacement.
- [Waivers](https://newhopevisa.com/en/waivers/): Inadmissibility waivers.
- [VAWA](https://newhopevisa.com/en/vawa/): Domestic violence — VAWA self-petition.
- [TPS](https://newhopevisa.com/en/temporary-protected-status-tps/): Temporary Protected Status.
